CB1D -> HTA tail (through the LB1 level to the cap)

flex_broadside.note: parallel-plate x 1.3 for fringing; area fixed by the core, the same on every unit

rx_tail.caveat: area only: the leak and pickup need the TX field at the lead path (phase 2: sbq_sim with the tail geometry); a twisted pair cancels by twist, the flex by thinness

eddy_loops.note: a tree has no closed loop; the receive grounds (VCM) reach AB1A only, AB1B joins through CB1D. Planes inside each hinge are hatched (rule 5); no stainless or aluminium stiffeners (the vendor offers both): FR4 or polyimide stiffeners only
